newsitem.title: GERMANY: MAS adds fourth Frankfurt flight Nov 5.
newsitem.headline: MAS adds fourth Frankfurt flight Nov 5.

text.p: Malaysia Airline System Bhd (MAS) said it will add a fourth weekly Frankfurt to Kuala Lumpur flight from November 5.
The new Boeing 747-400 passenger service will depart Frankfurt Wednesdays at 1230 local arriving in Kuala Lumpur at 0630 local time, a company statement said.
MAS will fly nonstop Mondays, Wednesdays, Fridays and Saturdays from Frankfurt with a B747-400 and Tuesdays and Sundays from Munich to Kuala Lumpur with a B777-200 under its winter 1997/98 schedule.
MAS said it could now offer the fastest time from Germany to New Zealand with less than 24 hours from Frankfurt to Auckland thanks to direct connections in Malaysia.
The opening of the new Kuala Lumpur International Airport at the start of 1998 would increase passenger traffic further, the airline said.
MAS would expand capacity from Germany to a daily flight to Kuala Lumpur and more than 70 Asia-Pacific destinations by the year 2000, it added.
